slice: PR 1 of 3: the touch D-pad as DOM over the Pixi stage, held by pointer with capture, emitting GameController.setControl as the keyboard does, released on pointerup, pointercancel, lostpointercapture, window blur and visibilitychange; 44px targets with 8px spacing, safe-area offsets, and the dive filling a landscape phone screen
workingTree: the runs below ran on the working tree that 590179a then committed unchanged; dist/ was built from it with `npx vite build` after `npm run typecheck`

environment.load: machine shared with other sessions' Playwright and Vitest runs; e2e started only once port 8080 was free

unit.note: at the default 5 s timeout, during another session's e2e run, 8 model tests this PR does not touch timed out (among them dive-end, dive-log, dive-model, game-controller-buoyancy)
